# Repository Instructions

- Project type: Vue 3 single-page website with Vite.
- Build output: `dist`.
- Deployment: GitHub Pages via `gh-pages`.
- Vite base path: relative (`./`) so the site works on GitHub Pages.
- Main files: `src/App.vue`, `src/main.js`, and `src/styles.css`.
- Keep changes minimal and consistent with the existing landing-page style.
